name: tr_billing_schedules
label: TR Billing Schedules
description: Traction Rec data, written by kroc-tractionrec-sync. Do not edit: the next sync overwrites every field. Source: TREX1__Planned_Billing_Schedule__c.

fields.name: tractionrec_id
fields.label: Traction Rec Id
fields.description: TREX1__Planned_Billing_Schedule__c.Id. The sync finds this item by it.

fields.name: active
fields.label: Active
fields.description: 1 = published online in Traction Rec now. 0 = no longer published (removed, outside its registration window, set Not Available, or its parent is gone); the site hides it. Set by the sync.

fields.name: inactive_reason
fields.label: Inactive Reason
fields.description: Why active is 0: Traction Rec's own reason (e.g. Outside Course Option Registration Timeframe), Removed from Traction Rec, or a missing parent. Empty when active.

fields.name: sync_hash
fields.label: Sync Hash
fields.description: Hash of this record's Traction Rec values. The sync rewrites the item only when it changes.

fields.name: synced_at
fields.label: Synced At
fields.description: When the sync last wrote this item (UTC).
